events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: *RAIN OR SHINE* Please arrive 1 hour prior to departure.All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing!Fuel Up for the Fun at Caf 1832While youre enjoying the rhythm of the rails, dont miss out on the delicious offerings from Caf 1832. Weve made it easier than ever to grab a bite by setting up a special remote kitchen right inside the Thomas tent! Whether youre looking for a hearty lunch or a quick snack, our team is ready to serve you. And for that classic fairground feel, be sure to stop by our Popcorn Wagon for a fresh-popped treat as you explore the grounds.More Than Just a Train RideThe excitement doesnt stop at the station! Make sure to catch our Live Entertainment, featuring performances that will have your little ones singing and dancing along to the beat. For an extra dose of history and fun, take a spin on our beloved Pufferbelly ride. This pint-sized steam experience is a fan favorite and the perfect way to round out your Day Out With Thomas.
events.please_note: *NO animals will be allowed on the property (except for authorized service dogs) during the Day Out With Thomas event. *Special Offers are not applicable for all train ride times. Most access codes are generally for Thomas train tickets only and are invalid for Saturday and Sunday train ride times between 11:00am - 1:59pm local time. *Event is rain or shine. *Event site hours are 9:30am to 5:00pm *Tickets are valid for the date and departure time printed on the ticket only *Arrive at least 45 minutes early, boarding lines form 15 minutes before each departure time. *Boarding announcements will be made throughout the day and passengers will be instructed to assemble at the boarding queue. *Seating for Thomas is available on a first-come, first-served basis. There is no reserved seating on the Thomas train. Parties wishing to sit together should be standing together in the boarding queue. *Train depart on time *Children under the age of 1 do not require a ticket, but must sit on the lap of a parent/guardian. *Tickets DO NOT include admission to the Railroad Museum of Pennsylvania nor does it include admission to the regular steam train. *All sales are final, no refunds or exchanges. *Railcars are Historic Coach Class and Open-Air Accommodations. *Due to the historic nature of our railcars, Strasburg Rail Road's passenger train does not meet current Americans with Disabilities Act standards with respect to accessibility. For individuals who use a wheelchair, a mobility device, or have difficulty navigating steps, we do have a mobile lift. (Please note: The mobile lift has a combined weight limitation of 400 pounds). Though we cannot guarantee accessibility, we have a variety of accommodation options available, and we will make a reasonable effort to provide each and every guest who wishes to ride the opportunity to do so. If you are concerned about whether you or a member of your traveling party will be able to board the train, we recommend contacting our business office to discuss your particular circumstances. The most efficient way to contact the Business Office is by emailing SRRTrain@strasburgrailroad.com. *Outside alcohol, drugs, and weapons are prohibited on railroad property. Strasburg Rail Road is a smoke-free property. Strasburg Rail Road does not permit pets or animals on trains or in customer-occupied areas of the station mall and train platform. Service animals are not considered pets and are permitted in all areas where customers are allowed.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: *RAIN OR SHINE* Please arrive 1 hour prior to departure.All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! Climb aboard for a train ride adventure with Thomas the Tank Engine at the Colorado Railroad Museum! Day Out With Thomas: Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is heading to Golden, Colorado with loads of music-inspired games and activities! Families can join the outdoor fun at the Colorado Railroad Museum, located in Goldens beautiful Clear Creek Valley. Take a real train ride with Thomas and spend the day creating memories for the whole family. Day Out With Thomas is an exciting way for children and grown-ups to enter the world of Thomas s full steam ahead to an unforgettable day with a host of train-related activities, Thomas, and a special appearance from Sir Topham Hatt, the Railway Controller from the Island of Sodor.
events.please_note: -Event will take place rain or shine. -Guests are asked to arrive at the event 30 minutes in advance, and to be in line 15 minutes before their scheduled departure time. Late afternoon riders arrive at least 90 min before your scheduled ride to enjoy all of the activities, which close at 5:00PM. -The time printed on your tickets is your train departure time. Trains will leave on time and cannot be held for late arrivals. -Tickets include a train ride at a designated time (selected at the time of purchase), plus admission to all activities for up to three hours. -All sales are final, there are no refunds. -Tickets are required for all riders ages 1 and up. Children 11 months and under are considered a lap rider, and must ride on an adult lap for the entire train ride -Guests must stay seated for the entire train ride -Both alcohol and cooking are prohibited. -Smoking is prohibited for the entire event site -The Museum will host a variety of onsite food vendors for lunch, snacks, drinks and dessert. Guests are welcome to bring a picnic lunch, however, please note that tables are unreserved and the Museum has no locker or storage facilities. No alcohol is allowed on the Museum grounds. All food must be prepared in advance; cooking onsite is prohibited. -NO PETS, and PETS are NOT allowed to be left in Parked Vehicles -Personal use photography only (no commercial use photography allowed during Thomas) -Rail cars are a mixture of open-air gondolas and coach cars with generous windows and plenty of fresh air. Open seating, no specific advance assignment. -Railcars do not offer restrooms or air conditioning. Guests are advised to use event restrooms before boarding. -Specific train cars are wheelchair accessible. For more information about Day Out With Thomas at the Colorado Railroad Museum, visit or call 303-279-4591.

Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing!Fuel Up for the Fun at Caf 1832While youre enjoying the rhythm of the rails, dont miss out on the delicious offerings from Caf 1832. Weve made it easier than ever to grab a bite by setting up a special remote kitchen right inside the Thomas tent! Whether youre looking for a hearty lunch or a quick snack, our team is ready to serve you. And for that classic fairground feel, be sure to stop by our Popcorn Wagon for a fresh-popped treat as you explore the grounds.More Than Just a Train RideThe excitement doesnt stop at the station! Make sure to catch our Live Entertainment, featuring performances that will have your little ones singing and dancing along to the beat. For an extra dose of history and fun, take a spin on our beloved Pufferbelly ride. This pint-sized steam experience is a fan favorite and the perfect way to round out your Day Out With Thomas.
events.please_note: *NO animals will be allowed on the property (except for authorized service dogs) during the Day Out With Thomas event. *Special Offers are not applicable for all train ride times. Most access codes are generally for Thomas train tickets only and are invalid for Saturday and Sunday train ride times between 11:00am - 1:59pm local time. *Event is rain or shine. *Event site hours are 9:30am to 5:00pm *Tickets are valid for the date and departure time printed on the ticket only *Arrive at least 45 minutes early, boarding lines form 15 minutes before each departure time. *Boarding announcements will be made throughout the day and passengers will be instructed to assemble at the boarding queue. *Seating for Thomas is available on a first-come, first-served basis. There is no reserved seating on the Thomas train. Parties wishing to sit together should be standing together in the boarding queue. *Train depart on time *Children under the age of 1 do not require a ticket, but must sit on the lap of a parent/guardian. *Tickets DO NOT include admission to the Railroad Museum of Pennsylvania nor does it include admission to the regular steam train. *All sales are final, no refunds or exchanges. *Railcars are Historic Coach Class and Open-Air Accommodations. *Due to the historic nature of our railcars, Strasburg Rail Road's passenger train does not meet current Americans with Disabilities Act standards with respect to accessibility. For individuals who use a wheelchair, a mobility device, or have difficulty navigating steps, we do have a mobile lift. (Please note: The mobile lift has a combined weight limitation of 400 pounds). Though we cannot guarantee accessibility, we have a variety of accommodation options available, and we will make a reasonable effort to provide each and every guest who wishes to ride the opportunity to do so. If you are concerned about whether you or a member of your traveling party will be able to board the train, we recommend contacting our business office to discuss your particular circumstances. The most efficient way to contact the Business Office is by emailing SRRTrain@strasburgrailroad.com. *Outside alcohol, drugs, and weapons are prohibited on railroad property. Strasburg Rail Road is a smoke-free property. Strasburg Rail Road does not permit pets or animals on trains or in customer-occupied areas of the station mall and train platform. Service animals are not considered pets and are permitted in all areas where customers are allowed.

events.info: *RAIN OR SHINE* Please arrive 1 hour prior to departure.All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Weve made it easier than ever to grab a bite by setting up a special remote kitchen right inside the Thomas tent! Whether youre looking for a hearty lunch or a quick snack, our team is ready to serve you. And for that classic fairground feel, be sure to stop by our Popcorn Wagon for a fresh-popped treat as you explore the grounds.More Than Just a Train RideThe excitement doesnt stop at the station! Make sure to catch our Live Entertainment, featuring performances that will have your little ones singing and dancing along to the beat. For an extra dose of history and fun, take a spin on our beloved Pufferbelly ride. This pint-sized steam experience is a fan favorite and the perfect way to round out your Day Out With Thomas.
events.please_note: *NO animals will be allowed on the property (except for authorized service dogs) during the Day Out With Thomas event. *Special Offers are not applicable for all train ride times. Though we cannot guarantee accessibility, we have a variety of accommodation options available, and we will make a reasonable effort to provide each and every guest who wishes to ride the opportunity to do so. Service animals are not considered pets and are permitted in all areas where customers are allowed.

events.info: -Please read fully for your enjoyment and others- BrownstoneJAZZ WEEKEND up close and personal. Bed Stuy, Bklyn and SugarHill, Harlem were both Jazz Hey Day Communities. When Ella Fitzgerald lyricized the song TAKE THE A TRAIN connecting NYCs two jazz hubs. Get your ticket for our private event. Both Eric and Debbie have been involved in the world of music entertainment for years presenting major artist. The list is long. They really know their way around the business.FOR A LIMITED TIME:Tables and seats have been limited. Make early purchases. We sell out fast. NOTESDRESS TO IMPRESS Its the Jazz Age! Casual Classy, Cocktail or vintage attire are encouraged. Leave the jeans, shorts, t-shirt, and hoodie at home.NO Athletic Wear, Tank Tops, or T-shirts in THE ROOMNO REFUNDS (no exceptions)ID is required NO PETS NO Shopping-bags or Backpacks in THE ROOM.BYOBB (bring your own brown bag) -NO FISH FRY OPTION-PLEASE PURCHASE ACTUAL TICKETS AS GIFTS WE ARE PRIVATE, please be respectful#jazz, #blues, #ticketweb, #ticketmaster, #music, #concerts, #datenight #events, #livemusic, #Brooklyn, #NYC, #Harlem

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.
events.please_note: PERCY TICKETS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE NEXT PAGE, AFTER YOU ADD THOMAS TICKETS TO YOUR CART AND CLICK AGREE & CHECKOUT -All sales are final, there are no refunds or exchanges -Site Hours are 8:00am-6:00pm -Ticket holders will receive an armband to grant them access to paid admission areas and all Thomas activities. Armbands need to be picked up at an entrance booth before site entry. Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. Under 1 do not require a ticket but must ride in the lap of a paying adult -Individuals ARE NOT permitted to walk around the grounds without a ticket. Arm bands must be displayed at all times. -Strollers will not be allowed on the Thomas or Percy train. A special parking area will be provided near the trains to leave strollers. Visitors are encouraged not to leave valuables in the strollers while they are left in this area. Please make sure your stroller is clearly identified with your name or other device since many strollers may appear similar when grouped together. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Visitors may take photos at a safe distance alongside the tracks or from the public walkways -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date printed on the ticket only. Event tickets grant access to the grounds for the entire day, but ride times are limited to the times on the tickets. -Arrive at least one hour early, trains depart on time, you may line up for boarding 20 minutes prior to train departure -Food and drink (except water) are not allowed on the Thomas/Percy trains or in certain exhibit areas. -No pets except approved service animals. -No climbing on rail equipment unless permitted by museum signs, No walking on tracks or in closed-off areas of property. -Outside food is allowed, but cannot be consumed on the trains -The museum is walking intensive and involves entering and exiting several buildings and outside areas. Visitors with mobility issues are encouraged to bring their own wheelchairs, walkers, etc, as required. -A lift is available on the train to help board passengers who may need a wheelchair. One car of the Thomas train has a wheelchair lift and several wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. One car of the Percy train has a wheelchair lift and two wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. All other cars of both the Thomas and Percy trains are not ADA/wheelchair accessible due to exemption for their vintage nature. Most areas of the site are ADA accessible. -The rail cars used for the ride are a mix of 1920s-1950s era coaches that have been professionally restored and maintained. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: *RAIN OR SHINE* Please arrive 1 hour prior to departure.All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! Climb aboard for a train ride adventure with Thomas the Tank Engine at the Colorado Railroad Museum! Day Out With Thomas: Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is heading to Golden, Colorado with loads of music-inspired games and activities! Families can join the outdoor fun at the Colorado Railroad Museum, located in Goldens beautiful Clear Creek Valley. Take a real train ride with Thomas and spend the day creating memories for the whole family. Day Out With Thomas is an exciting way for children and grown-ups to enter the world of Thomas s full steam ahead to an unforgettable day with a host of train-related activities, Thomas, and a special appearance from Sir Topham Hatt, the Railway Controller from the Island of Sodor.
events.please_note: -Event will take place rain or shine. -Guests are asked to arrive at the event 30 minutes in advance, and to be in line 15 minutes before their scheduled departure time. Late afternoon riders arrive at least 90 min before your scheduled ride to enjoy all of the activities, which close at 5:00PM. -The time printed on your tickets is your train departure time. Trains will leave on time and cannot be held for late arrivals. -Tickets include a train ride at a designated time (selected at the time of purchase), plus admission to all activities for up to three hours. -All sales are final, there are no refunds. -Tickets are required for all riders ages 1 and up. Children 11 months and under are considered a lap rider, and must ride on an adult lap for the entire train ride -Guests must stay seated for the entire train ride -Both alcohol and cooking are prohibited. -Smoking is prohibited for the entire event site -The Museum will host a variety of onsite food vendors for lunch, snacks, drinks and dessert. Guests are welcome to bring a picnic lunch, however, please note that tables are unreserved and the Museum has no locker or storage facilities. No alcohol is allowed on the Museum grounds. All food must be prepared in advance; cooking onsite is prohibited. -NO PETS, and PETS are NOT allowed to be left in Parked Vehicles -Personal use photography only (no commercial use photography allowed during Thomas) -Rail cars are a mixture of open-air gondolas and coach cars with generous windows and plenty of fresh air. Open seating, no specific advance assignment. -Railcars do not offer restrooms or air conditioning. Guests are advised to use event restrooms before boarding. -Specific train cars are wheelchair accessible. For more information about Day Out With Thomas at the Colorado Railroad Museum, visit or call 303-279-4591.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.
events.please_note: PERCY TICKETS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE NEXT PAGE, AFTER YOU ADD THOMAS TICKETS TO YOUR CART AND CLICK AGREE & CHECKOUT -All sales are final, there are no refunds or exchanges -Site Hours are 8:00am-6:00pm -Ticket holders will receive an armband to grant them access to paid admission areas and all Thomas activities. Armbands need to be picked up at an entrance booth before site entry. Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. Under 1 do not require a ticket but must ride in the lap of a paying adult -Individuals ARE NOT permitted to walk around the grounds without a ticket. Arm bands must be displayed at all times. -Strollers will not be allowed on the Thomas or Percy train. A special parking area will be provided near the trains to leave strollers. Visitors are encouraged not to leave valuables in the strollers while they are left in this area. Please make sure your stroller is clearly identified with your name or other device since many strollers may appear similar when grouped together. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Visitors may take photos at a safe distance alongside the tracks or from the public walkways -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date printed on the ticket only. Event tickets grant access to the grounds for the entire day, but ride times are limited to the times on the tickets. -Arrive at least one hour early, trains depart on time, you may line up for boarding 20 minutes prior to train departure -Food and drink (except water) are not allowed on the Thomas/Percy trains or in certain exhibit areas. -No pets except approved service animals. -No climbing on rail equipment unless permitted by museum signs, No walking on tracks or in closed-off areas of property. -Outside food is allowed, but cannot be consumed on the trains -The museum is walking intensive and involves entering and exiting several buildings and outside areas. Visitors with mobility issues are encouraged to bring their own wheelchairs, walkers, etc, as required. -A lift is available on the train to help board passengers who may need a wheelchair. One car of the Thomas train has a wheelchair lift and several wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. One car of the Percy train has a wheelchair lift and two wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. All other cars of both the Thomas and Percy trains are not ADA/wheelchair accessible due to exemption for their vintage nature. Most areas of the site are ADA accessible. -The rail cars used for the ride are a mix of 1920s-1950s era coaches that have been professionally restored and maintained. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

Take a real train ride with Thomas and spend the day creating memories for the whole family. Day Out With Thomas is an exciting way for children and grown-ups to enter the world of Thomas s full steam ahead to an unforgettable day with a host of train-related activities, Thomas, and a special appearance from Sir Topham Hatt, the Railway Controller from the Island of Sodor.

All food must be prepared in advance; cooking onsite is prohibited. -NO PETS, and PETS are NOT allowed to be left in Parked Vehicles -Personal use photography only (no commercial use photography allowed during Thomas) -Rail cars are a mixture of open-air gondolas and coach cars with generous windows and plenty of fresh air. Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.

Armbands need to be picked up at an entrance booth before site entry. Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.
events.please_note: PERCY TICKETS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE NEXT PAGE, AFTER YOU ADD THOMAS TICKETS TO YOUR CART AND CLICK AGREE & CHECKOUT -All sales are final, there are no refunds or exchanges -Site Hours are 8:00am-6:00pm -Ticket holders will receive an armband to grant them access to paid admission areas and all Thomas activities. Armbands need to be picked up at an entrance booth before site entry. Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. Under 1 do not require a ticket but must ride in the lap of a paying adult -Individuals ARE NOT permitted to walk around the grounds without a ticket. Arm bands must be displayed at all times. -Strollers will not be allowed on the Thomas or Percy train. A special parking area will be provided near the trains to leave strollers. Visitors are encouraged not to leave valuables in the strollers while they are left in this area. Please make sure your stroller is clearly identified with your name or other device since many strollers may appear similar when grouped together. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Visitors may take photos at a safe distance alongside the tracks or from the public walkways -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date printed on the ticket only. Event tickets grant access to the grounds for the entire day, but ride times are limited to the times on the tickets. -Arrive at least one hour early, trains depart on time, you may line up for boarding 20 minutes prior to train departure -Food and drink (except water) are not allowed on the Thomas/Percy trains or in certain exhibit areas. -No pets except approved service animals. -No climbing on rail equipment unless permitted by museum signs, No walking on tracks or in closed-off areas of property. -Outside food is allowed, but cannot be consumed on the trains -The museum is walking intensive and involves entering and exiting several buildings and outside areas. Visitors with mobility issues are encouraged to bring their own wheelchairs, walkers, etc, as required. -A lift is available on the train to help board passengers who may need a wheelchair. One car of the Thomas train has a wheelchair lift and several wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. One car of the Percy train has a wheelchair lift and two wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. All other cars of both the Thomas and Percy trains are not ADA/wheelchair accessible due to exemption for their vintage nature. Most areas of the site are ADA accessible. -The rail cars used for the ride are a mix of 1920s-1950s era coaches that have been professionally restored and maintained. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.
events.please_note: PERCY TICKETS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE NEXT PAGE, AFTER YOU ADD THOMAS TICKETS TO YOUR CART AND CLICK AGREE & CHECKOUT -All sales are final, there are no refunds or exchanges -Site Hours are 8:00am-6:00pm -Ticket holders will receive an armband to grant them access to paid admission areas and all Thomas activities. Armbands need to be picked up at an entrance booth before site entry. Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. Under 1 do not require a ticket but must ride in the lap of a paying adult -Individuals ARE NOT permitted to walk around the grounds without a ticket. Arm bands must be displayed at all times. -Strollers will not be allowed on the Thomas or Percy train. A special parking area will be provided near the trains to leave strollers. Visitors are encouraged not to leave valuables in the strollers while they are left in this area. Please make sure your stroller is clearly identified with your name or other device since many strollers may appear similar when grouped together. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Visitors may take photos at a safe distance alongside the tracks or from the public walkways -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date printed on the ticket only. Event tickets grant access to the grounds for the entire day, but ride times are limited to the times on the tickets. -Arrive at least one hour early, trains depart on time, you may line up for boarding 20 minutes prior to train departure -Food and drink (except water) are not allowed on the Thomas/Percy trains or in certain exhibit areas. -No pets except approved service animals. -No climbing on rail equipment unless permitted by museum signs, No walking on tracks or in closed-off areas of property. -Outside food is allowed, but cannot be consumed on the trains -The museum is walking intensive and involves entering and exiting several buildings and outside areas. Visitors with mobility issues are encouraged to bring their own wheelchairs, walkers, etc, as required. -A lift is available on the train to help board passengers who may need a wheelchair. One car of the Thomas train has a wheelchair lift and several wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. One car of the Percy train has a wheelchair lift and two wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. All other cars of both the Thomas and Percy trains are not ADA/wheelchair accessible due to exemption for their vintage nature. Most areas of the site are ADA accessible. -The rail cars used for the ride are a mix of 1920s-1950s era coaches that have been professionally restored and maintained. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.
events.please_note: PERCY TICKETS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE NEXT PAGE, AFTER YOU ADD THOMAS TICKETS TO YOUR CART AND CLICK AGREE & CHECKOUT -All sales are final, there are no refunds or exchanges -Site Hours are 8:00am-6:00pm -Ticket holders will receive an armband to grant them access to paid admission areas and all Thomas activities. Armbands need to be picked up at an entrance booth before site entry. Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. Under 1 do not require a ticket but must ride in the lap of a paying adult -Individuals ARE NOT permitted to walk around the grounds without a ticket. Arm bands must be displayed at all times. -Strollers will not be allowed on the Thomas or Percy train. A special parking area will be provided near the trains to leave strollers. Visitors are encouraged not to leave valuables in the strollers while they are left in this area. Please make sure your stroller is clearly identified with your name or other device since many strollers may appear similar when grouped together. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Visitors may take photos at a safe distance alongside the tracks or from the public walkways -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date printed on the ticket only. Event tickets grant access to the grounds for the entire day, but ride times are limited to the times on the tickets. -Arrive at least one hour early, trains depart on time, you may line up for boarding 20 minutes prior to train departure -Food and drink (except water) are not allowed on the Thomas/Percy trains or in certain exhibit areas. -No pets except approved service animals. -No climbing on rail equipment unless permitted by museum signs, No walking on tracks or in closed-off areas of property. -Outside food is allowed, but cannot be consumed on the trains -The museum is walking intensive and involves entering and exiting several buildings and outside areas. Visitors with mobility issues are encouraged to bring their own wheelchairs, walkers, etc, as required. -A lift is available on the train to help board passengers who may need a wheelchair. One car of the Thomas train has a wheelchair lift and several wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. One car of the Percy train has a wheelchair lift and two wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. All other cars of both the Thomas and Percy trains are not ADA/wheelchair accessible due to exemption for their vintage nature. Most areas of the site are ADA accessible. -The rail cars used for the ride are a mix of 1920s-1950s era coaches that have been professionally restored and maintained. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.
events.please_note: PERCY TICKETS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE NEXT PAGE, AFTER YOU ADD THOMAS TICKETS TO YOUR CART AND CLICK AGREE & CHECKOUT -All sales are final, there are no refunds or exchanges -Site Hours are 8:00am-6:00pm -Ticket holders will receive an armband to grant them access to paid admission areas and all Thomas activities. Armbands need to be picked up at an entrance booth before site entry. Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. Under 1 do not require a ticket but must ride in the lap of a paying adult -Individuals ARE NOT permitted to walk around the grounds without a ticket. Arm bands must be displayed at all times. -Strollers will not be allowed on the Thomas or Percy train. A special parking area will be provided near the trains to leave strollers. Visitors are encouraged not to leave valuables in the strollers while they are left in this area. Please make sure your stroller is clearly identified with your name or other device since many strollers may appear similar when grouped together. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Visitors may take photos at a safe distance alongside the tracks or from the public walkways -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date printed on the ticket only. Event tickets grant access to the grounds for the entire day, but ride times are limited to the times on the tickets. -Arrive at least one hour early, trains depart on time, you may line up for boarding 20 minutes prior to train departure -Food and drink (except water) are not allowed on the Thomas/Percy trains or in certain exhibit areas. -No pets except approved service animals. -No climbing on rail equipment unless permitted by museum signs, No walking on tracks or in closed-off areas of property. -Outside food is allowed, but cannot be consumed on the trains -The museum is walking intensive and involves entering and exiting several buildings and outside areas. Visitors with mobility issues are encouraged to bring their own wheelchairs, walkers, etc, as required. -A lift is available on the train to help board passengers who may need a wheelchair. One car of the Thomas train has a wheelchair lift and several wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. One car of the Percy train has a wheelchair lift and two wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. All other cars of both the Thomas and Percy trains are not ADA/wheelchair accessible due to exemption for their vintage nature. Most areas of the site are ADA accessible. -The rail cars used for the ride are a mix of 1920s-1950s era coaches that have been professionally restored and maintained. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

Visitors who received their tickets via email in advance should present their tickets at any information booth or the Will Call/ Ticket Box Office booths to receive armbands. -All visitors are required to have a ticket for ages 1 and up. Under 1 do not require a ticket but must ride in the lap of a paying adult -Individuals ARE NOT permitted to walk around the grounds without a ticket. Arm bands must be displayed at all times. -Strollers will not be allowed on the Thomas or Percy train. A special parking area will be provided near the trains to leave strollers. Visitors are encouraged not to leave valuables in the strollers while they are left in this area. Please make sure your stroller is clearly identified with your name or other device since many strollers may appear similar when grouped together. The museum is not responsible for lost or stolen items. -Digital, film and video cameras are welcome at the museum. Visitors may not stand on railroad tracks for photos. Visitors may take photos at a safe distance alongside the tracks or from the public walkways -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date printed on the ticket only. Event tickets grant access to the grounds for the entire day, but ride times are limited to the times on the tickets. -Arrive at least one hour early, trains depart on time, you may line up for boarding 20 minutes prior to train departure -Food and drink (except water) are not allowed on the Thomas/Percy trains or in certain exhibit areas. -No pets except approved service animals. -No climbing on rail equipment unless permitted by museum signs, No walking on tracks or in closed-off areas of property. -Outside food is allowed, but cannot be consumed on the trains -The museum is walking intensive and involves entering and exiting several buildings and outside areas. Visitors with mobility issues are encouraged to bring their own wheelchairs, walkers, etc, as required. -A lift is available on the train to help board passengers who may need a wheelchair. One car of the Thomas train has a wheelchair lift and several wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. One car of the Percy train has a wheelchair lift and two wheelchair spaces along with accompanying seating. All other cars of both the Thomas and Percy trains are not ADA/wheelchair accessible due to exemption for their vintage nature. Most areas of the site are ADA accessible. -The rail cars used for the ride are a mix of 1920s-1950s era coaches that have been professionally restored and maintained. Some cars have opening windows, others have sealed windows with air conditioning as needed. Although we will do our best to accommodate passenger requests for open window or air-conditioned cars, we cannot guarantee availability. -Groups with specific seating requests or wishing to sit together should board together and are encouraged to arrive early. Staff will do its best to accommodate requests, but cannot guarantee specific requests. -All passengers are loaded from a single boarding line for each ride time.

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends
events.info: All Aboard for a Rockin Good Time! Day Out With Thomas:Lets Rock, Lets Roll Tour is hitting the tracks and bringing the beat to heritage railways across the country! Hop on board for a real train ride with Thomas, strike a pose at photo ops and snag something cool at the exclusive gift shop. Then, keep the beat going at the Music Corner, packed with lawn games, hands-on activities, and music-inspired fun thatll have the whole family dancing! All aboard for a rockin good time! Thomas the Tank Engine, everyones favorite #1 blue engine, is coming to town. Day Out With Thomas will be stopping at the North Carolina Transportation Museum with a celebration of music on September 25-27 and October 2-4, 2026.Day Out With Thomas is a fun-filled family event that takes place at Heritage Railways across the world. Each ticket includes a train ride with a life-sized Thomas the Tank Engine as well as access to a full day of activities for all to enjoy. Optional rides with Percy are also available for an additional cost.The event at the N.C. Transportation Museum includes Thomas and Percy train rides, pictures with Sir Topham Hatt, a hay bale maze, temporary tattoos, photo ops, character inflatables, giant lawn games, a music show, model train layouts, food vendors, picnic shelters, a large gift shop, plus three exhibit buildings featuring North Carolinas transportation history with rail cars, antique automobiles, and a Wright Brothers flyer replica. All-Day Ride PassA limited number of all-day ride passes are available for Fridays, September 25 and October 2. The all-day ride passes allow multiple rides behind Thomas the Tank Engine during the day. All-day Percy ride passes cannot be purchased without holding all-day Thomas ride passes. Fans without the all-day ride passes are welcome to enjoy the event activities all day long but are limited to only the one ride time they have selected for the Thomas train and the optional Percy train. Breakfast With Sir Topham HattStart your day out with a pancake breakfast (pancakes, sausage, a fruit cup and juice) onboard a stationary train car. You will get a chance to meet and get your picture taken with Sir Topham Hatt, the Controller of the Railway (picture sold separately). Everyone ages 1 and up must have a Sir Topham Hatt Breakfast ticket to board the breakfast train cars. Children under the age of 1 are free but must sit on the lap of a paying member of the party and will not be served a meal unless a ticket was purchased for them. Seating is limited. Two 45-minute breakfast seatings are offered, from 8:15 am until 9:00 am and from 9:15 am until 10:00 am. Breakfast tickets are only available to those who also have a Day Out With Thomas event ticket. Please note that the breakfast train cars are not on a moving train. Breakfast train cars are not ADA accessible due to the vintage nature of their construction, and participants must be able to climb up and down steps on the train car to attend breakfast.

events.name: BrownstoneJAZZ FEST CONCERT SERIES
events.info: -Please read fully for your enjoyment and others- BrownstoneJAZZ WEEKEND up close and personal. Intimate acoustic room live concertsFridays & Saturdays 7:30pm or 9:30pmSundays 4pm or 6pmExperience the JazzFest in a restored 19th Century Victorian Brownstone located in Bedford Stuyvesants Central Brooklyn Landmarked Historical Community. Where you will feel transported back to an earlier time period walking through the doors. BrownstoneJAZZ Ensasmbles present the best of yesteryears jazz soldiers and todays jazz frontier musicians, swinging with the authentic jazz style. Something for everyone to enjoy. Bed Stuy, Bklyn and SugarHill, Harlem were both Jazz Hey Day Communities. When Ella Fitzgerald lyricized the song TAKE THE A TRAIN connecting NYCs two jazz hubs. BrownstoneJAZZ invites you to the magic of music with Curator Debbie McClain and M.C., Bassist Eric Lemons hosting you as you uncover this old school jazz venue to enjoy a different jazz experience. Get your ticket for our private event. Both Eric and Debbie have been involved in the world of music entertainment for years presenting major artist. The list is long. They really know their way around the business.FOR A LIMITED TIME:Tables and seats have been limited. Make early purchases. We sell out fast. NOTESDRESS TO IMPRESS Its the Jazz Age! Casual Classy, Cocktail or vintage attire are encouraged. Leave the jeans, shorts, t-shirt, and hoodie at home.NO Athletic Wear, Tank Tops, or T-shirts in THE ROOMNO REFUNDS (no exceptions)ID is required NO PETS NO Shopping-bags or Backpacks in THE ROOM.BYOBB (bring your own brown bag) -NO FISH FRY OPTION-PLEASE PURCHASE ACTUAL TICKETS AS GIFTS WE ARE PRIVATE, please be respectful#jazz, #blues, #ticketweb, #ticketmaster, #music, #concerts, #datenight #events, #livemusic, #Brooklyn, #NYC, #Harlem

events.name: Day Out With Thomas (TM), Thomas & Friends

venue.name: Museum of the American Railroad & Grapevine Vintage Railroad

events.info: *RAIN OR SHINE* Please arrive 1 hour prior to departure.Time to Party with Thomas the Tank Engine! Day Out With Thomas: The Party Tour is making its way to heritage railways across the country offering an exciting day for the whole family. Enjoy a real train ride with Thomas, live entertainment, photo ops, and the exclusive gift shop. Then, head over to the Celebration Station for lawn games and activities! Spend the day creating memories and celebrating 80 years of Thomas!

For those requiring accessibility options, the train has limited accessible access. The event grounds are accessible. -The train consists of five all-steel, heavyweight, ex-commuter coaches with high density seating. Two of the five cars have open sides with safety railing. All coaches are air conditioned. No open-air coaches available. -All passengers holding tickets for a given day and time are guaranteed a seat on that train. -BOX OFFICE INFO (Hours, location, advance sales, accepted payment methods) 705 S. events.info: *RAIN OR SHINE* Please arrive 1 hour prior to departure.Time to Party with Thomas the Tank Engine! Day Out With Thomas: The Party Tour is making its way to heritage railways across the country offering an exciting day for the whole family. Enjoy a real train ride with Thomas, live entertainment, photo ops, and the exclusive gift shop. Then, head over to the Celebration Station for lawn games and activities! Spend the day creating memories and celebrating 80 years of Thomas!
events.please_note: -Site Hours FRI 9:30AM-5:30PM SAT 9:30AM-6:30PM SUN 9:30AM-6:30PM -Train times printed on tickets are departure times. We are working trains around an active commuter rail line. Due to this, trains will leave on time and cannot delay departure for late arrivals. -Special offers are not available on all train times -Event is rain or shine -Tickets are valid for the date and train departure time printed on the ticket only. -Please be in line to board your train at least 20 min prior to your train time -Arrive at least one hour early (30 min for the 10am train), trains depart on time -No smoking allowed on the train or at the event site. -No outside food or beverages((with the exception of baby formula, baby food, special dietary needs) -No glass containers or coolers. -No Alcohol -No Solicitation -No pets or animals (service animals are welcome). -Children under the age of 1 do not require a ticket, but must sit on the lap of a parent/guardian. -All children age 16 and under must be accompanied by an adult. -Please notify the railroad in advance of any special needs. For those requiring accessibility options, the train has limited accessible access. The event grounds are accessible. -The train consists of five all-steel, heavyweight, ex-commuter coaches with high density seating. Two of the five cars have open sides with safety railing. All coaches are air conditioned. No open-air coaches available. -All passengers holding tickets for a given day and time are guaranteed a seat on that train. -BOX OFFICE INFO (Hours, location, advance sales, accepted payment methods) 705 S. Main Street, Grapevine, TX 76051 -All sales are final, no refunds

events.name: Patti Smith: Dodge Poetry Festival
events.info: The punk poet laureate comes home to New Jersey for a night of songs and stories. A true renaissance woman, Patti Smith immense influence has saturated literature, music, visual arts, politics and global culture for over 50 years. She has written dozens of books, including National Book Award winner Just Kids. Her seminal album, 1975 Horses, was inducted into both the GRAMMY Hall of Fame and the National Recording Registry at the Library of Congress. Her countless honors include Frances Legion dHonneur, Swedens Polar Prize, and the PEN Literary Service Award. Part of the Dodge Poetry Festival

events.name: Patti Smith: Dodge Poetry Festival
events.info: Singer, songwriter, poet, painter, author, and photographer Patti Smith emerged in the 1970s punk rock scene. Her intellectual and angry lyrics, along with her energetic performances, helped redefine the role of women in rock and shape the direction of the punk genre. Smith is known for fusing rock and poetry, and her music is characterized by its poetic lyricism and rock & roll energy.

events.info: BrownstoneJAZZ FEST up close and personal. Intimate acoustic room live concerts , Experience the JazzFest in a restored 19th Century Victorian Brownstone located in Bedford Stuyvesants Central Brooklyn Landmarked Historical Community. Where ou will feel transported back to earlier time as you walk through the doors. BrownstoneJAZZ Ensambles present the best of yesteryears jazz soldiers and todays jazz frontier. Musicians, swinging with an authentic jazz style. Something for everyone to enjoy Bed Stuy, Bklyn and SugarHill, Harlem were both Jazz Hey Day Communities. When Ella Fitzgerald lyricized the song TAKE THE A TRAIN connecting NYCs two jazz hubs. Youre invited to the magic of music with Curator Debbie McClain and M.C., Bassist Eric Lemons hosting you as you uncover this old school jazz venue to enjoy a different jazz experience. venue.name: Museum of the American Railroad & Grapevine Vintage Railroad

events.info: *RAIN OR SHINE* Please arrive 1 hour prior to departure.Time to Party with Thomas the Tank Engine! Day Out With Thomas: The Party Tour is making its way to heritage railways across the country offering an exciting day for the whole family. Enjoy a real train ride with Thomas, live entertainment, photo ops, and the exclusive gift shop. Then, head over to the Celebration Station for lawn games and activities! Spend the day creating memories and celebrating 80 years of Thomas!

events.name: Mission Bayfest Saturday 10/17/2026
events.info: The 5th annual Mission Bayfest returns on October 16-18, 2026, at the scenic Mariners Point Park! Join us for an unforgettable weekend where high energy musical performances meet paradise. Fans can immerse themselves in the festival vibe with over 30 electrifying acts across 3 stages, as San Diegos finest DJs keep the energy alive between sets. Relax and explore the picturesque park with its sand, water, and grassy landscapes, all while enjoying a variety of delicious offerings from local food vendors. Sip on craft beers and cocktails mixed by talented bartenders, and get ready for a music festival experience that feels like a mini-resort escape. This is your chance to be part of an iconic celebration. See you at Mission Bayfest 2026! No refunds rain or shine
events.please_note: SATURDAY ONLY Tickets for Mission Bayfest 2026 are flying dont wait! Prices go up soon and this event will sell out. Lock in your spot now for October 16 at Mariners Point Park in San Diego! There is no difference in location, access, or experience between General Admission Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, or Tier 4. The only difference is the price and the number of tickets available in each tier. Once a tier sells out, the next tier becomes active at a higher price. So the earlier you buy, the more you save! This is an ALL AGES event. All ticket sales are final. No refunds or exchanges will be provided. In the case of a cancellation, all tickets will be valid at the rescheduled date. Refunds will be issued if a rescheduled date does not take place within 180 days. Festival will happen RAIN or SHINE. Come prepared!

events.name: Disney On Ice presents Find Your Hero
attractions: Disney On Ice presents Find Your Hero
events.info: Unlock your inner hero when Disney On Ice brings your favorite stories to the ice! Sail away with Moana and Maui on their epic voyage to return the heart of Te Fiti. Feel the chill with Anna, Elsa, and Olaf as they race to restore summer in Arendelle. Move to the rhythms of Encanto as Mirabel and her family celebrate the power of every unique gift. Be inspired by the Disney Princesses as you swim under the sea with Ariel, visit the enchanted castle with Belle, and chase your dreams alongside Rapunzel. Watch out for Stitch as his mischievous acts spark laughter around every corner. Hosted by Mickey and Friends, Disney On Ice presents Find Your Hero is a dazzling celebration of courage, kindness, and togetherness that will thrill every Disney fan! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more information.

Your cabana package includes:VIP Agave Show tickets for 6 guestsA bottle of premium Tequila CorridoA 12-taco platter for your groupDedicated cabana servicePrivate shaded lounge seatingIts the ultimate way to enjoy Taco Fest combining great food, premium agave spirits, and the energy of the festival with the comfort of your own private space.A portion of all ticket sales benefits our 501(c) charitable partner, XICO Latino & Indigenous Arts Organization.GENERAL ADMISSION TICKETSGeneral access to the festival.
